ash.$description: Cool green-grey neutral (paper and ink). Primitive: reference only from semantic tokens.

sap.$description: Sap green, the single accent hue; also success. Primitive: reference only from semantic tokens.

woad.$description: Woad blue for focus, info and code. Primitive: reference only from semantic tokens.

weld.$description: Weld yellow for warnings. Primitive: reference only from semantic tokens.

madder.$description: Madder red for danger and errors. Primitive: reference only from semantic tokens.

amount.$description: Mixing, opacity and filter amounts in percent (see codex.unit). Primitive.

base.$description: Page background and the default canvas behind all content. Use once per page, on body.

raised.$description: Framed objects that sit on the page: cards, accession labels, the sticky header, table bodies. Never as page background.

sunken.$description: Recessed areas that hold machine text: code blocks, inline code, table header rows, keyboard keys.

hover.$description: Background of an interactive row or card while hovered. Only as a hover state; never at rest.

inverse.$description: Background of tooltips and other small transient labels that must stand out from every surface. Never for panels or cards.

highlight.$description: Text selection and <mark>. Never for large areas or decoration.

primary.$description: Body copy, headings and any text a reader must read. Default text colour.

secondary.$description: Supporting reading text: ledes, summaries, captions, blockquotes. Still AAA, so it can carry full sentences.

muted.$description: Metadata only: dates, reading time, counts, label keys. Never for sentences or body copy (AA, not AAA).

accent.$description: Short accent text: accession numbers, eyebrow labels, the current nav item. Never for paragraphs; use color.link.* for links.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons placed on color.accent.fill.*, such as primary button labels. Only on accent fills.

rest.$description: Inline links in running text. Always underlined so colour is not the only cue.

hover.$description: Inline link while hovered or focused. Pair with a thicker underline, not colour alone.

subtle.$description: Decorative dividers inside a component: table row rules, list separators. Never the only boundary of a control.

default.$description: Outlines of non-interactive framed objects: cards, labels, code blocks, figures.

strong.$description: Boundaries of interactive controls (secondary buttons, inputs, toggles) and hovered card outlines. Meets 3:1 non-text contrast.

rest.$description: Fill of the one primary action in a view. One per view; never for large panels.

hover.$description: Fill of a primary action while hovered or pressed.

border.$description: Accent rules that mark the active item: current nav underline, active TOC entry, hovered tag. Not for static decoration.

ring.$description: Keyboard focus outline on every focusable element. Always drawn with border.focus.offset so it sits on the surface, not the control.

rest.$description: Yarndings ornaments and the specimen plate's contour lines. Decorative only: always aria-hidden, never carries meaning.

strong.$description: Emphasised stitches that trace structure inside an ornament, and the plate's index contours (every fifth line). Decorative only; never for text.

muted.$description: Registration ticks on framed objects and the plate's survey grid. Decorative only; no contrast requirement.

text.$description: Short labels and titles that signal a completed or passing state. Always paired with a text label, never colour alone.

surface.$description: Background of a callout or banner that signals a completed or passing state. Body text on it uses color.text.primary.

border.$description: Emphasis rule on a component that signals a completed or passing state, e.g. a callout's leading edge.

text.$description: Short labels and titles that signal a caution the reader should act on. Always paired with a text label, never colour alone.

surface.$description: Background of a callout or banner that signals a caution the reader should act on. Body text on it uses color.text.primary.

border.$description: Emphasis rule on a component that signals a caution the reader should act on, e.g. a callout's leading edge.

text.$description: Short labels and titles that signal an error, a destructive action or a breaking change. Always paired with a text label, never colour alone.

surface.$description: Background of a callout or banner that signals an error, a destructive action or a breaking change. Body text on it uses color.text.primary.

border.$description: Emphasis rule on a component that signals an error, a destructive action or a breaking change, e.g. a callout's leading edge.

text.$description: Short labels and titles that signal neutral supplementary information. Always paired with a text label, never colour alone.

surface.$description: Background of a callout or banner that signals neutral supplementary information. Body text on it uses color.text.primary.

border.$description: Emphasis rule on a component that signals neutral supplementary information, e.g. a callout's leading edge.

comment.$description: Code comments and doc strings. Upright, never italic (no mono italic is loaded). Only inside code blocks on color.surface.sunken.

keyword.$description: Language keywords and control flow: if, return, const, import. Only inside code blocks on color.surface.sunken.

string.$description: String, regex and template literals. Only inside code blocks on color.surface.sunken.

number.$description: Numbers, booleans, null and other literal constants. Only inside code blocks on color.surface.sunken.

function.$description: Function and method names at definition and call sites. Only inside code blocks on color.surface.sunken.

type.$description: Types, classes, built-ins and namespaces. Only inside code blocks on color.surface.sunken.

tag.$description: Markup tag names (HTML, JSX, XML). Only inside code blocks on color.surface.sunken.

attribute.$description: Markup attributes, object keys and CSS properties. Only inside code blocks on color.surface.sunken.

variable.$description: Identifiers and plain names. Same value as body text so most code reads as text. Only inside code blocks on color.surface.sunken.

operator.$description: Operators and punctuation such as = => . , ; ( ). Only inside code blocks on color.surface.sunken.

meta.$description: Decorators, annotations, preprocessor directives and shebangs. Only inside code blocks on color.surface.sunken.

inserted.$description: Diff lines that were added. Pair with the + prefix, never colour alone. Only inside code blocks on color.surface.sunken.

deleted.$description: Diff lines that were removed and error tokens. Pair with the - prefix. Only inside code blocks on color.surface.sunken.

heading.$description: Diff hunk headers and markup headings inside code. Only inside code blocks on color.surface.sunken.

line-number.$description: Line numbers in the gutter of a code block. Only inside code blocks on color.surface.sunken.

line-highlight.$description: Background of emphasised lines in a code block (Chroma hl_lines). Only inside code blocks.

1.$description: The first series in diagrams and charts. Use series in order, label every series directly, and never rely on hue alone.

2.$description: The second series in diagrams and charts. Use series in order, label every series directly, and never rely on hue alone.

3.$description: The third series in diagrams and charts. Use series in order, label every series directly, and never rely on hue alone.

4.$description: The fourth series in diagrams and charts. Use series in order, label every series directly, and never rely on hue alone.

5.$description: The fifth series in diagrams and charts. Use series in order, label every series directly, and never rely on hue alone.

tint.$description: Share of color.surface.base laid over the backdrop contours, in percent: a light frost that softens the sharp hairlines without hiding them, behind the home page's statement and the footer.

grain.$description: Opacity of the monochrome grain over the frost, in percent. Texture only; never raise it until it competes with text.

saturation.$description: Saturation applied to the backdrop contours under the frost, in percent, so their colour stays green instead of greying out.

calm.$description: Strength the backdrop contours keep where text sits on the frost, in percent: on the left, where the statement and the footer start, and along the header. They come up to full strength towards the open side. A mask amount only.

hover.$description: Share of color.text.primary mixed into a transparent hover background, in percent: header controls on the frosted backdrop, where a solid color.surface.hover would match the frost. Not for controls on a plain surface.
